connector.name: Proton Mail MCP
connector.registryDescription: Proton Mail MCP via Bridge (IMAP/SMTP) · 13 tools · dual transport stdio + HTTP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package proton-mail-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alexendros account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_HOST
env.description: Hostname or IP of the Proton Mail Bridge (default: 127.0.0.1 for local, or container hostname in compose).

env.name: PROTON_IMAP_PORT
env.description: IMAP port exposed by Proton Mail Bridge (default: 1143).

env.name: PROTON_SMTP_PORT
env.description: SMTP port exposed by Proton Mail Bridge (default: 1025).

env.name: PROTON_PASSWORD
env.description: Bridge-generated app password (NOT your Proton account password).
